name: Masked Wavelet Representation for Compact Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A neural radiance field representation that combines 2D plane-based decomposition (TensoRF), multi-level discrete wavelet transform (DWT) on the 2D matrices, trainable binary masks to induce sparsity, and a compression pipeline (n-bit casting, RLE, Huffman) to store the sparse coefficients and masks compactly.
summary: MW-NeRF compresses neural radiance fields by applying wavelet transforms and trainable masks to grid coefficients, achieving high sparsity and state-of-the-art performance within a 2 MB memory budget.
